descriptionByLocale.en:
Associate R&D Specialist Flavors

Nestlé Institute of Food Sciences

Welcome to Nestlé Research, a global organization, with most of our passionate team located in Lausanne, Switzerland! Our work is powered by five specialized Nestlé Institutes and key strategic units. Here, we think fresh and collaborate to create amazing solutions. How about taking a step inside our organization and discover the exciting research activities and expertise that drive us forward? Want to learn more !

Position Snapshot: Your opportunity to #breakthrough with us!

Location: Nestlé Research, Lausanne, Switzerland

Institute: Nestlé Institute of Food Science

Company: Société des Produits Nestlé S.A.
Act. Rate: Full-Time Act. Rate 100%
Type of contract: 2-year contract

What we offer at Nestlé

Exciting opportunities to develop your career your way; across different brands, businesses, functions, and regions.

Flexible working arrangements - facilitating creativity and collaboration.

A culture of respect, with diversity, equity and inclusion at its core.

A dynamic international environment empowering you to learn, develop and grow.

Don’t hesitate to connect with us during the recruitment process to learn more

Position Summary

As an “ Associate R&D Specialist Flavors” in Nestlé Research, you will be instrumental in advancing the innovation and renovation within Flavor Science. Your work will span across all categories in Nestlé, catering both tasty and nutritious products, for consumers and their pet friends.

Thanks to your passion and scientific expertise, you will develop robust scientific and innovative solutions to decode and modulate taste and aroma in order to enhance sensory experiences for our consumers. Collaborating with multidisciplinary experts, you will drive the collection, interpretation and application of scientific findings into the development of new product concepts and address business opportunities. You will also have the opportunity to shape and implement the future scientific strategy in this field, engaging with internal and external experts and various business partners.

A Day in the Life of an Associate R&D Specialist Flavors

• Embrace innovation as a catalyst for change: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive cutting-edge research in aroma and taste mastery, leveraging your flavor expertise and developing impactful prototypes. Communicate effectively with impact to different stakeholders, e.g., institute heads, stream leaders, project managers, and business stakeholders. Propose new projects and activities that align with our research goals and business needs.

• Make a meaningful impact on our world: Lead project activities to meet defined objectives and timelines, coordinating with experts in sensory science, perception physiology, and material science. Manage project budgets effectively and ensure seamless knowledge transfer to Product Technology Centers.

• Foster a culture of creativity and growth : Engage with diverse thought leaders to spark fresh ideas and entrepreneurial initiatives. Identify technical gaps and opportunities and stay updated on the latest trends and methods. Propose innovative ideas by merging technical knowledge with business insights and exploring external partnerships.

• Stay at the forefront of science by monitoring the latest development in flavor sciences, and sharing relevant external technologies in both academia and industry

What Will Make You Successful

• Ph.D. in Food Chemistry and Food Sciences with knowledge of flavor generation and transformation, ideally with industrial experience

• Research and applied science experience in the field of reaction flavours, Maillard reactions, lipid oxidations, and linking to sensory benefits

• Practical experience in analytical laboratory, with a focus on volatile and non-volatiles (GC-MS, GC-O, LC/MS)

• Proficiency in programming languages, e.g. Python & R, and experience in statistical analysis (e.g., PLS and PCA) and data visualization

• Basic knowledge of sensory techniques

• Ability to translate complex scientific results to easily understood way that instils credibility across different stakeholders

• Excellent communication skills in English (written/spoken)

• Networking skills and proactivity

• People at Core: Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively in diverse teams, fostering an environment that encourages fresh thinking and values contributions. Display openness, flexibility, and creativity in problem-solving while cultivating strong networking and teamwork abilities

• Innovation at Heart: Proven track record in driving innovative projects that challenge the status quo and contribute to breakthrough solutions, alongside experience in modeling or diet formulation

• Driven by Passion, Inspired by People: Strong commitment to promoting well-being and a positive workplace culture, ensuring all team members feel valued

Exciting Opportunity Ahead! After submitting your application, you will receive an invitation to create a short video introduction, guided by a few specific questions. This is your chance to showcase your personality and passion.

We kindly ask that you submit your video within 7 days of your application to ensure we can assess your profile thoroughly. Please note that if this step is not completed within the specified time, we will assume you have chosen to withdraw your application

Nestlé is committed to the accessibility of its recruitment process. If you require an adaptation during the recruitment process, please do let us know so we can support you effectively. All information will be treated confidentially.

At Nestlé, we want to help shape a better and healthier world, inspire people to live healthier lives and deliver impact at a scale and pace that makes a difference. We do this by fostering a diverse, friendly, supportive, and collaborative environment, that creates positive disruption, embraces innovation, and empowers people and teams to win. We aim to hire friendly, respectful, inspiring people who care about the people’s lives that we touch every single day.

Be a force for good. Join Nestlé and visit us on www.nestle.com .

Together, we make breakfast better.

As a Global SHE Lead at CPW, your mission is to lead and strengthen our Safety, Health and Environment strategy across our factories, distribution centers and Head Offices. You will make a difference by working closely with local SHE teams, factory leadership, and internal and external stakeholders. This is your opportunity to make breakfast better and help people start their day in the best possible way.

How you’ll make an impact as a Global SHE Lead

• Embed safety as a core leadership value by strengthening accountability and ensuring SHE is fully integrated into daily decision-making and operational routines.

• Drive SHE cultural transformation at shopfloor level by elevating frontline leadership behaviours through targeted coaching, and impactful communication.

• Deploy global SHE standards across CPW factories, ensuring consistency while enabling local ownership and high-performing safety cultures.

• Strengthen risk management and resilience by driving robust audit frameworks and proactive prevention plans to reduce operational risks.

• Build sustainable capability by developing factory leaders and SHE professionals, reinforcing expertise, mindset and long-term compliance.

• Accelerate continuous improvement by identifying, sharing and scaling best practices and innovative solutions across sites.

• Influence business performance by partnering cross-functionally to elevate SHE outcomes and support safe, sustainable operations.

What will make you successful

• Bringing proven experience in Safety within complex industrial environments, with a strong track record in driving safety culture transformation. Experience operating and influencing across regional or global organizations is a plus, while hands-on leadership experience at shopfloor level remains a strong advantage.

• Strong expertise in SHE management systems, auditing and risk management, complemented by recognized safety certifications (e.g., NEBOSH, ISO Lead Auditor or equivalent).

• Highly effective stakeholder influencer, able to engage, challenge and align leaders across functions, geographies and levels of the organization.

• Clear and impactful communicator, fluent in English (French is a plus), capable of connecting with audiences from shopfloor teams to senior leadership.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Location: Orbe, Switzerland
Work model: On site / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Target start date: As soon as possible

Be a force for good and grow through experiences that push you further

As Machine Quality Senior Specialist at Nestlé Product Technology Center for Coffee & Beverages , your mission is to build trust and deliver outstanding consumer experiences by embedding food safety, compliance and quality into beverage systems of both Nespresso and Nestlé Dolce Gusto from the earliest design stages. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with project managers, category teams, factories, regulatory and legal partners, consumer services and suppliers. This is your opportunity to drive cutting-edge innovation, strengthen your expertise and deliver meaningful results to create unique consumer experiences at global scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Machine Quality Senior Specialist

• Safeguarding food safety, regulatory compliance and consumer expectations throughout beverage-system development.

• Embedding quality by design across new products, packaging, machines and production lines to improve right-first-time delivery.

• Driving robust validation plans, quality requirements and process capability from ideation through technical approval and launch.

• Anticipating quality risks through root-cause analysis, risk assessment and failure mode analysis, enabling pragmatic decisions.

• Resolving quality issues with factories and consumer service teams and ensuring corrective actions strengthen future developments.

• Building quality capability by coaching colleagues, sharing knowledge across sites and turning project lessons into continuous improvement.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong knowledge of quality systems, food safety, good manufacturing practices, product development and manufacturing.

• Applying root-cause analysis, risk analysis and failure mode analysis to complex design and production challenges.

• Using project management skills to align priorities, manage several developments and deliver practical solutions.

• Collaborating assertively and transparently, influencing decisions while balancing quality requirements with business realities.

• Demonstrating agility and adaptability while navigating complexity, shifting priorities and evolving project needs.

• Communicating fluently and effectively in English across all levels of the organization; proficiency in additional languages is an advantage.

At Nestlé, we care about our people

We offer a competitive and well-rounded benefits package designed to support your growth and wellbeing at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process
We are committed to a fair and transparent internal hiring process and ensure all applications are treated confidentially.

Your application will typically include an initial review, conversations with Talent Acquisition and the hiring team, followed by a final discussion.

Ready to grow with us?

Apply now and grow through experiences that push you further.

Chez Nespresso Suisse nous pensons qu’il est possible d’élever l’univers du café et nous voulons contribuer positivement à changer les vies et les paysages pour le mieux. Élu meilleur employeur 2025, nous plaçons chacun de nos 14 000 collaborateurs, sans exception, au cœur de notre réussite. Pour y parvenir, nous adoptons quatre comportements essentiels : « We Inspire, we Care, we Act, and we iNnovate ». Et vous ? Voulez-vous nous accompagner dans cette aventure passionnante ? Rejoignez l’équipe Nespresso ! Et réimaginez la nature du café. Réimaginez votre avenir.

Instantané du poste

Lieu : Romont, Switzerland

Entité : Centre de Production Nespresso
Taux : Temps plein 100%

Type de contrat : Contrat indéterminé

Ce que nous offrons chez Nespresso

De réelles opportunités d’évolution de carrière et de développement personnel

Un cadre de travail flexible facilitant la créativité et la collaboration

Une culture fondée sur la bienveillance et l’inclusivité, où chacun peut être soi-même

La qualité et la durabilité au cœur de notre identité et une vision essentielle pour favoriser le changement positif L’opportunité de travailler pour une entreprise certifiée B Corp, et l'une des marques les plus fiables et appréciées à l’échelle mondiale.

Au cours du processus de recrutement, n’hésitez pas à nous en parler pour en savoir plus !

Découvrez notre page Linkedin : Nespresso Centres de production

Découvrez nos métiers : Métiers Nespresso - YouTube

Résumé du poste

En tant qu’Opérateur.trice torréfaction en horaire d’équipe 4x8 (H/F/D), vous serez responsable d’assurer le fonctionnement des installations de torréfaction.

Une journée dans la vie d’un(e) Opérateur.trice torréfaction en horaire d’équipe 4x8 (H/F/D)

• Effectuer la conduite des installations de torréfaction

• S’assurer que toutes les lignes soient alimentées en café selon le plan de production

• Maîtriser le fonctionnement des périphériques de la torréfaction et entretenir les installations

• Anticiper et réagir de façon appropriée aux événements ayant une incidence sur la sécurité, la qualité, les performances et sur les pertes

• Assurer la transmission de l’information en respectant l’agenda du passage de consignes d’équipe à équipe

• Participer à l’amélioration continue dans le cadre de la structure d’amélioration continue en place.

Vos atouts pour réussir

• CFC dans un domaine technique ou alimentaire

• Expérience en tant que conducteur de ligne (ou similaire) dans l'industrie agro-alimentaire ou pharmaceutique

• Expérience en torréfaction ou en tant qu'opérateur process, un atout

• Maîtrise du français

• Maîtrise des outils informatiques standards.

Avantages

• 5 semaines de vacances

• Possibilité de formation et de développement internes

• Caisse de pension avec excellentes contributions de l’employeur

• Participation financière à l’assurance maladie

• Politique parentalité avantageuse

• Restaurant d’entreprise sur place avec menus à prix subventionnés

• Parking gratuit et bornes de recharge pour voitures électriques

• Nombreux avantages auprès du Club Nespresso

Chez Nespresso, nous avons bâti une culture fondée sur la bienveillance et l’inclusion, où chacun peut être soi-même, tout en grandissant avec l’entreprise. Nous innovons, nous osons essayer de nouvelles choses, nous apprenons et évoluons dans un environnement numérique et connecté où tout va très vite. Au sein d’une équipe diverse regroupant plus de 90 nationalités dans 58 pays, vous pouvez prendre part à cette culture innovante, dans laquelle les personnes se soutiennent et s’entraident. Une culture dans laquelle chacun est encouragé à remettre en question le statu quo et à avoir un impact sur l’avenir de l’une des plus grandes entreprises durables au monde. Quel que soit le rôle que vous jouerez, vous découvrirez que vous pouvez réellement changer les choses et partager votre enthousiasme. Rejoignez ce lieu où vous pourrez vous épanouir, trouver une appartenance et l’inspiration pour devenir le meilleur de vous-même et vous surpasser.

titleByLocale.fr: Performance Acceleration Senior Analyste - Nestlé Operations

descriptionByLocale.en:
Location: Vevey, Switzerland
Work model: On site / Full time
Contract type: Permanent

Travel Rate: 100% (Around 90% factory-based and 10% HQ-based)

Programme: 4-year development programme with 5–6-month international factory assignments across Nestlé’s global Operations network

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet

As a Performance Acceleration Senior Analyst at Nestlé Operations, you will join a unique 4-year development programme, completing international assignments of 5-6 months in Nestlé factories around the world. Your mission will be to accelerate operational performance and drive sustainable improvements across our global manufacturing network. You'll make a difference by collaborating closely with local factory teams, R&D experts, and corporate stakeholders.

With extensive international travel and hands-on exposure to complex manufacturing operations, this is your opportunity to grow your career, work across diverse cultures and production environments, and build a strong network within Nestlé's global Operations community.

How you’ll make an impact as a Performance Acceleration Senior Analyst

• Driving continuous improvement initiatives that enhance performance, productivity, and competitiveness across factories worldwide.

• Leading operational optimization and digital transformation projects that deliver measurable and sustainable results.

• Collaborating with factory leadership teams, technical experts, and global stakeholders to accelerate implementation and value creation.

• Coaching teams and supporting capability building to embed best practices and sustain long-term improvements.

• Managing cross-functional projects while leveraging Nestlé's global network to share knowledge, benchmark performance, and accelerate innovation.

• Strengthening operational excellence capabilities by promoting manufacturing standards and continuous learning across markets.

What will make you successful

• Bringing experience in a factory environment, such as production, quality, engineering, or related manufacturing functions. Previous line management experience is a plus.

• Applying strong project leadership and problem-solving skills to deliver meaningful business improvements.

• Using coaching and influencing capabilities to engage, develop, and support diverse teams.

• Embracing a highly international role that combines extensive travel, long-term factory assignments, and collaboration with diverse teams across different cultures and markets.

• Communicating fluently in English; additional language skills are an advantage.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning.

At Nestlé, we place people at the heart of everything we do.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an assessment, an interview with the hiring team and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to Be a Force for Good?

Apply now and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

Location: Vevey, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

As a Global Medical Communication Lead at Nestlé Nutrition and Health, your mission is to shape global, healthcare professional-centred communication for the premium vitamin, mineral and supplement portfolio, translating the latest science into compelling branded and non-branded engagements that support new and existing products. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with marketing, regulatory and scientific affairs, nutrition science, research and development, regional and market teams, external agencies, research partners and scientific experts. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and make a difference at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Global Medical Communication Lead

• Developing global engagement and communication plans that strengthen healthcare professional understanding and increase recommendation, advocacy and adoption across the premium vitamin, mineral and supplement portfolio.

• Creating compelling scientific communication materials across in-person, digital and social channels to support new product launches and established product concepts.

• Shaping market awareness initiatives that build scientific credibility and support sustainable portfolio growth.

• Leading global programmes, congress activities, round tables and branded and non-branded advisory engagements that deepen trusted relationships with healthcare professionals.

• Collaborating across global, regional and market teams to deliver communication toolkits that are relevant, consistent and ready for local adoption.

• Building productive partnerships with scientific experts and key opinion leaders (KOLs), agencies and research partners to turn insight and evidence into meaningful engagement.

What will make you successful

• Bringing substantial medical marketing experience in nutrition, pharmaceuticals or consumer healthcare environments.

• Applying scientific and regulatory awareness, including familiarity with external guidelines and regulations relevant to healthcare professional and advocacy relations to develop credible branded and non-branded healthcare professional programmes and materials.

• Using strategic planning, data analysis and project leadership to move multiple priorities from insight to action, with global experience highly preferred.

• Collaborating with influence and integrity across global teams while building trusted internal and external relationships.

• Communicating fluently in English.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning.

At Nestlé Nutrition and Health, we place people at the heart of everything we do.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

As the Head of Global Business Services Finance at Nestlé, your mission is to act as a key finance partner to the Head of GBS and the GBS Management Team. You will shape the financial roadmap, challenge business decisions, and ensure disciplined planning, performance management, cost transparency and value realization across the global GBS network. Working closely with Center Heads, End-to-End solution leads, Global Process Owners, Markets, IT & Digital, and external partners, you will provide forward-looking insights, enable fact-based decisions, and strengthen accountability for financial outcomes. You will lead an international finance team in different locations and help GBS deliver sustainable efficiency, effectiveness, and business value.

How you’ll make an impact as a Head of GBS Finance

• Bring deep expertise in the operational financial management of Global Business Services, using cost, efficiency, quality and service-performance insights to improve both efficiency and effectiveness.

• While leveraging AI tools, develop and maintain unit-cost, productivity and service-performance measures that connect financial outcomes with operational volumes, quality and service levels. Use internal and external benchmarks to identify improvement opportunities.

• Planning, coordinating and maintaining cost control of our Business Centers operations, measuring performance against plan and proposing necessary action plans to achieve targets in a context of important transition plan.

• Ensure challenging stretched targets are set for each Shared Service Center, end-to-end solution lead and Management Services unit, and tracking performance in a timely manner.

• Establish and govern a consistent framework to validate, track and report productivity, transformation benefits and value delivery, including agreed baselines, ownership, timing and reconciliation to reported financial results.

• Ensure a robust, documented and transparent billing and reconciliation process across the GBS network, including accurate and timely charges to internal customers, clear allocation drivers, dispute resolution and compliance with applicable transfer-pricing and accounting requirements.

• Own and continuously improve a transparent, driver-based costing and charging model for GBS services. Define financial evaluation and performance-tracking methodologies, assess business cases and contract changes, and ensure continuity plans reflect current financial exposures and operational requirements.

• Lead financial and commercial governance of external service providers, including contract economics, rate cards, indexation, volume commitments, service credits, change requests, invoice validation and value-for-money assessments.

• Lead, develop and inspire your team in an international environment while working collaboratively and cross functionally with IT & Digital, Global Process Owners and Markets.

What will make you successful

• Demonstrating senior finance leadership experience in GBS operational financial models and in complex global organizations, supported by relevant finance, accounting or business qualification.

• Applying financial analysis and co-piloting experience to various senior stakeholders through a strong command of management accounting, planning and forecasting, service costing, investment appraisal, financial controls and commercial contract management.

• Developing and improving financial systems and major business processes, with exposure to audit, project financial evaluation and contract reviews.

• Strong focus on compliance, rock solid reporting and internal controls.

• Managing and developing people, including virtual teams, with good organizational and planning skills.

• Communicating fluently in English, with superior written and verbal communication skills to effectively address and influence all levels, leadership team and internal customers.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

Location: Lausanne, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Technician in Lipids & Metabolic Analytics department at Nestlé Research, your mission is to provide analytical support in lipids analytics and deliver timely, high-quality data that supports research, innovation, and operational needs. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with scientists, experts, peers across analytical groups, and external partners. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as a Technician in Lipids Analytics

• Delivering timely, high-quality lipid data that advances research projects and supports operational priorities.

• Executing lipid extraction and chromatography experiments with accuracy, and rigor.

• Implementing analytical methods and technical solutions that improve lipid analysis capabilities.

• Advancing innovation by exploring and applying new analytical technologies that expand what is possible in lipids analytics.

What will make you successful

• Bringing knowledge in lipid classes, lipid extraction, and the analysis of lipophilic compounds with a similar position in industry or in academia.

• Applying knowledge of gas chromatography and liquid chromatography methods to deliver precise analytical results.

• Collaborating with a quality-focused, proactive and curiosity mindset while working confidently across diverse teams and stakeholders.

• Communicating fluently in French and English is a plus.

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset.

At Nestlé Research, we place people at the core of everything we do.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Il s'agit d'un vivier de talent. Vous serez uniquement contacté en cas d'ouverture d'un poste

Lieu : Fabrique d’Orbe, Suisse
Entité : Nestlé Suisse S.A.
Taux : CDI 100%

La Fabrique de Nestlé Suisse SA à Orbe est une référence dans la fabrication du café soluble Nescafé et de thé Special.T. Nous vous offrons un poste dans un environnement de travail dynamique favorisant l'initiative au sein d'un site industriel en plein développement où notre mission est d'atteindre l’excellence.

Résumé de la position

Notre département Engineering s’assure 7/7j et 24/24h de la disponibilité de nos installations du point de vue technique par des actions préventives, correctives, et maintenance et d’amélioration. En tant que Technicien.ne de maintenance en horaire 5x8, vous êtes responsable de la surveillance et de la maintenance de nos installations complexes de fabrication de café soluble, dans le strict respect des règles de sécurité et d'hygiène.

Une journée dans la vie d’un(e) Technicien(ne) de maintenance à la Fabrication café en 5x8

• Réaliser les dépannages des installations complexes de production de café et rédiger les rapports d’intervention.

• Procéder aux activités de maintenance préventive (mécanique, électricité) pour garantir le maintien en service des équipements.

• Analyser les causes racines des pannes et identifier les mesures de fiabilisation des lignes.

• Identifier et remonter les opportunités d'améliorations techniques sur les installations.

• Renseigner le système de gestion selon les activités réalisées (SAP)

• Participer à la création et à la mise à jour des procédures techniques.

• Durant les maintenances annuelles, assurer les activités du secteur défini en tant que leader.

• Participer à l’amélioration continue du secteur grâce aux outils TPM tels que tagging, 5s etc.

• Participer activement à la culture de la sécurité et qualité (LOTO, EPI, etc.

• Collaborer, échanger et transmettre les informations techniques avec le personnel de production et technique.

Ce qui fera votre réussite

• CFC dans le domaine technique ou Technicien ES (mécanicien-électricien / automaticien ou équivalent)

• Expérience confirmée dans la maintenance et le dépannage en industrie

• Compréhension approfondie d’installations complexes de production

• Disponibilité pour travailler en horaire d’équipe 5x8 (critère pour ce poste)

• Aisance digitale et maîtrise des outils informatiques standards; connaissances de SAP sont un atout

• Autorisation de raccordement OIBT15 ou 13 est un plus

• Compétences en usinage, soudage et serrurerie est un plus.

• Autonomie, rigueur, bonne résistance au stress

• Bonnes compétences analytiques, de synthèse et de résolution de problèmes (BDA)

• Esprit d'initiative et d'équipe, orientation service

Ce que nous vous offrons :

• De réelles opportunités de développement professionnel et personnel

• Caisse de pension avec excellentes contributions de l’employeur

• Un environnement de travail en évolution, international, dynamique et bienveillant

• Des avantages sociaux attractifs

Prêt(e) à relever le défi ? Postulez à ce vivier de talent !

Taux : CDI 100%

La Fabrique de Nestlé Suisse SA à Orbe est une référence dans la fabrication du café soluble Nescafé et de thé Special.T. Nous vous offrons un poste dans un environnement de travail dynamique favorisant l'initiative au sein d'un site industriel en plein développement où notre mission est d'atteindre l’excellence.

Résumé de la position

Notre département Engineering s’assure 7/7j et 24/24h de la disponibilité de nos installations du point de vue technique par des actions préventives, correctives, et maintenance et d’amélioration. En tant que Technicien.ne de maintenance en horaire 5x8, vous êtes responsable de la surveillance et de la maintenance de nos installations complexes de fabrication de café soluble, dans le strict respect des règles de sécurité et d'hygiène.

Une journée dans la vie d’un(e) Technicien(ne) de maintenance à la Fabrication café en 5x8

• Réaliser les dépannages des installations complexes de production de café et rédiger les rapports d’intervention.

• Procéder aux activités de maintenance préventive (mécanique, électricité) pour garantir le maintien en service des équipements.

• Analyser les causes racines des pannes et identifier les mesures de fiabilisation des lignes.

• Identifier et remonter les opportunités d'améliorations techniques sur les installations.

• Renseigner le système de gestion selon les activités réalisées (SAP)

• Participer à la création et à la mise à jour des procédures techniques.

• Durant les maintenances annuelles, assurer les activités du secteur défini en tant que leader.

• Participer à l’amélioration continue du secteur grâce aux outils TPM tels que tagging, 5s etc.

• Participer activement à la culture de la sécurité et qualité (LOTO, EPI, etc.

• Collaborer, échanger et transmettre les informations techniques avec le personnel de production et technique.

Ce qui fera votre réussite

• CFC dans le domaine technique ou Technicien ES (mécanicien-électricien / automaticien ou équivalent)

• Expérience confirmée dans la maintenance et le dépannage en industrie

• Compréhension approfondie d’installations complexes de production

• Disponibilité pour travailler en horaire d’équipe 5x8 (critère pour ce poste)

• Aisance digitale et maîtrise des outils informatiques standards; connaissances de SAP sont un atout

• Autorisation de raccordement OIBT15 ou 13 est un plus

• Compétences en usinage, soudage et serrurerie est un plus.

• Autonomie, rigueur, bonne résistance au stress

• Bonnes compétences analytiques, de synthèse et de résolution de problèmes (BDA)

• Esprit d'initiative et d'équipe, orientation service

Ce que nous vous offrons :

• De réelles opportunités de développement professionnel et personnel

• Caisse de pension avec excellentes contributions de l’employeur

• Un environnement de travail en évolution, international, dynamique et bienveillant

• Des avantages sociaux attractifs

Prêt(e) à relever le défi ? Postulez à ce vivier de talent !

Reimagin what coffee can be. Imagine what you can become.

As a Trainee Production Engineer and/or Logistics + Continuous Improvement, you study, propose and take charge of setting up a continuous improvement structure inspired by TPM (Total Performance Management) on production lines or in logistics area.

• Analyze trends in the area's performance indicators (reliability, planned stops, minor stops, losses, blockages, etc.) in order to initiate problem-solving approaches or improvement projects and take the necessary actions to achieve the objectives

• Updating procedures and standards and ensuring their application

What Will Make Your Success

• Experience in the food industry (an asset)

Als Trainee Production Engineer und/oder Logistics + Continuous Improvement studieren, schlagen und übernehmen Sie den Aufbau einer von TPM (Total Performance Management) inspirierten kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsstruktur an Produktionslinien oder im Logistikbereich.

Wie werden Sie als Produktionsingenieur und/oder Logistikpraktikant + Kontinuierliche Verbesserung wirken?

• Analysieren Sie Trends in den Leistungsindikatoren des Gebiets (Zuverlässigkeit, geplante Stopps, kleinere Stopps, Verluste, Blockaden usw.), um Problemlösungsansätze oder Verbesserungsprojekte zu initiieren und die notwendigen Maßnahmen zur Erreichung der Ziele zu ergreifen
• Gewährleistung der Schnittstelle zwischen Produktion und/oder Logistik und den verschiedenen Abteilungen und Gewährleistung der Überwachung, Durchführung und Kommunikation von Maßnahmen zur Verbesserung des Gebiets
• Koordination von kontinuierlichen Verbesserungs-, TPM- und Digitalisierungsaktivitäten zwischen Teams und Coach bei der Analyse und Lösung wiederkehrender Probleme
• Aktualisierung der Verfahren und Standards und Gewährleistung ihrer Anwendung

• Student in der Schule des Ingenieurs
• Kenntnisse über kontinuierliche Verbesserung und/oder TPM-Tools
• Erfahrung in der Lebensmittelindustrie (ein Asset)
• Problemanalyse und Lösungskapazität
• Fähigkeit, in einem multidisziplinären Team zu arbeiten
• Kommunikation.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Location: Vevey, Switzerland, with regular travel to Orbe and other Nestlé R&D sites
Work model: Full-time, 100%
Contract type / duration: Permanent
Closing Date for Applications: 15th September 2026

Be a force for good and grow through experiences that push you further

As a Patent Counsel in Digital & AI, your mission is to enable and protect Nestlé’s digital, AI-driven and electronics-centric innovations through pragmatic legal services and business-driven IP protection. You will act as the go-to Legal R&D partner for Digital & AI topics across the Nestlé R&D ecosystem, collaborating closely with R&D teams, Patent Counsels, R&D Counsels and IP Analysts. This is your opportunity to shape and grow the IP strategy for one of Nestlé’s most strategic innovation frontiers.

How you’ll make an impact as a Patent Counsel – Digital & AI

• Develop and deliver the IP strategy for digital, AI and electronics-driven innovations, in close partnership with R&D teams, the patent team, R&D Counsels and IP Analysts.

• Lead business-driven patent filing and prosecution, Freedom-to-Operate assessments, oppositions of third-party patents and defense against third-party oppositions.

• Manage your patent portfolio with strong business alignment and rigorous cost management.

• Advise on IP matters in R&D collaborations, including Digital & AI partnerships, licensing and joint developments.

• Support Coffee & Systems and other categories on connected systems, digital platforms and AI-based innovations, in collaboration with category Patent Counsels.

• Partner with Nestlé Research, the Nestlé Deep Tech Center, NPTC – Nestlé Professional and other R&D centers to protect digital and AI innovations across categories.

• Promote passion for IP through awareness sessions, training and communication, while contributing to the awareness and enforcement of Nestlé patents in R&D and in the markets.

What will make you successful

Ce qui vous fera réussir

• Expérience éprouvée dans les projets de propriété intellectuelle liés au numérique, à l'intelligence artificielle et/ou à l'électronique, y compris idéalement les inventions mises en œuvre par des logiciels, l'intelligence artificielle/ML, les appareils connectés et les méthodes commerciales mises en œuvre par ordinateur.

• Plus de 3 ans d'expérience post-qualification dans la rédaction des brevets, les poursuites et les évaluations Freedom-to-Operate dans l'espace numérique, électronique ou AI.

• Expérience de l'élaboration de stratégies de propriété intellectuelle axées sur l'entreprise dans plusieurs pays, avec une compréhension solide des caractéristiques des logiciels et des brevets d'IA telles que l'OEB, l'USPTO et l'INPA.

- Gestire i rifiuti
- Rifornire le linee con materiale d’imballaggio
- Assicurarsi della corretta applicazione del 5S
- Fornire supporto alle linee di produzione

I vostri punti di forza per avere successo

- Esperienza nell’industria agroalimentare o farmaceutica
- Padronanza del francese

Innoviamo, osiamo provare cose nuove, impariamo e ci evolviamo in un ambiente digitale e connesso in cui tutto va molto velocemente. All’interno di un team eterogeneo che riunisce più di 90 nazionalità in 58 Paesi, puoi partecipare a questa cultura innovativa, nella quale le persone si sostengono e si aiutano a vicenda. Una cultura nella quale ciascuno è incoraggiato a mettere in discussione lo status quo e ad avere un impatto sul futuro di una delle più grandi aziende sostenibili al mondo. Qualunque sia il ruolo che ricoprirai, scoprirai che puoi davvero cambiare le cose e condividere il tuo entusiasmo. Unisciti a noi in questo luogo dove potrai realizzarti, trovare un senso di appartenenza e l’ispirazione per diventare la versione migliore di te stesso e superare te stesso.

Essere una forza per il bene e crescere attraverso esperienze che ti spingono oltre.

Come Specialista di Formulazione Ricetta IF & Toddler, la vostra missione è quella di guidare il ciclo di vita della ricetta del prodotto dal nuovo breve prodotto al lancio, assicurando la formulazione conforme, la gestione efficace delle ricette e l'eccellenza delle specifiche degli ingredienti. Potrai fare la differenza collaborando a stretto contatto con le operazioni, la qualità, la produzione, il prodotto, la ricerca e lo sviluppo, le squadre di regolazione e affari medici in mercati e fabbriche. Questa è la vostra opportunità di prendere la proprietà, crescere la vostra esperienza, e fare la differenza in scala.

Come farete un impatto come ricetta Formulation Specialist IF & Toddler

• Sviluppo della ricetta conforme al piombo dalla breve del prodotto al lancio, assicurando formulazioni scientificamente robuste tra categorie, fabbriche e mercati.

• Traduci la scienza della formulazione in ricette fit-for-purpose integrando funzionalità degli ingredienti, obiettivi nutrienti, perdite di processo, evoluzione della shelf-life e fattibilità di produzione.

• Costruisci capacità tecniche condividendo competenze di formulazione, best practice, standard e formazione con specialisti di ricetta e ingredienti, Sviluppatori di prodotti, CTAG, AG e stakeholder interfunzionali.

• Fornire supporto alle decisioni tecniche attraverso proposte di formulazione, valutazioni di trade-off, analisi di variabilità e mitigazione del rischio proattivo attraverso ingredienti, qualità, regolazione, nutrizione e dimensioni di produzione.

• Semplificazione e armonizzazione delle ricette, degli ingredienti e delle specifiche per ridurre la complessità del portafoglio, migliorare l'efficienza operativa e sostenere le attività di scale-up o trasferimento.

• Essere una forza per i continui miglioramenti sfidando le pratiche e i processi esistenti, migliorando gli strumenti esistenti, tracciando e segnalando per aumentare la visibilità del portafoglio.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Istruzione scientifica in Scienze alimentari, Tecnologia alimentare, Chimica, Farmacista o un campo correlato, combinato con una forte esperienza pratica nella formulazione delle ricette, conformità e gestione dei prodotti alimentari o alimentari.

• Solida comprensione dei contributi degli ingredienti, delle perdite di processo e di shelf-life, della fattibilità produttiva e dell'ambiente normativo, con la capacità di tradurre questi fattori in soluzioni di ricetta conformi e robuste.

• Esperienza di lavoro in team interfunzionali e forte competenza in sistemi e strumenti digitali rilevanti, tra cui SAP-RM e una comprensione di DevEX e CAT, insieme ad eccellenti competenze di comunicazione inglese, sia scritte che verbali.

Be a force for good and grow through experiences that push you further.

As a Recipe Formulation Specialist IF & Toddler, your mission is to drive the product recipe lifecycle from new product brief to launch, ensuring compliant formulation, effective recipe management and ingredient specification excellence. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with operations, quality, manufacturing, product, research and development, regulatory and medical affairs teams across markets and factories. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and make a difference at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Recipe Formulation Specialist IF & Toddler

• Lead compliant recipe development from product brief to launch, ensuring scientifically robust formulations across categories, factories, and markets.

• Translate formulation science into fit-for-purpose recipes by integrating ingredient functionality, nutrient targets, process losses, shelf-life evolution, and manufacturing feasibility.

• Embed compliance by design throughout innovation and renovation projects, ensuring validation, approvals, and documentation align with category rules, internal standards, and external requirements.

• Build technical capability by sharing formulation expertise, best practices, standards, and training with recipe and ingredient specialists, Product Developers, CTAGs, AGs, and cross-functional stakeholders.

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Junior Research Assistant in Packaging Safety at Nestlé Research, your mission is to develop, validate and apply analytical methods for novel coated paper packaging materials. You will make a difference by collaborating closely with teammates, research colleagues, operations teams, quality managers and external partners. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as a Junior Research Assistant in Packaging Safety

• Contribute to the development of robust analytical methods that help assess the safety and performance of innovative packaging materials.

• Perform packaging characterization analyses that support reliable research outcomes and project decisions.

• Consolidating and interpreting data and writing clear analytical documentation that enables quality, research and project teams to act with confidence.

• Participate in transferring analytical methods to operations and supporting end users throughout the method lifecycle.

• Contributing to quality, safety and knowledge-sharing practices that help teams work consistently across sites.

• Engage with internal and external partners to stay at the forefront of packaging safety science and analytical technologies.

What will make you successful

• Master’s degree in chemistry, analytical chemistry or a related scientific discipline, combined with a strong interest in analytical sciences, packaging safety and sustainable packaging technologies.

• Applying knowledge of gas chromatography-mass spectrometry, liquid chromatography-high resolution mass spectrometry or material characterization.

• Using hands-on laboratory experience from academic projects, internships or research activities to deliver reliable experimental work.

• Collaborating with curiosity, attention to detail and strong data analysis, problem-solving and scientific reporting skills.

• Working proficiency in English and French.

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset.

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Gestalten Sie die Zukunft durch wissenschaftliche Durchbrüche und Innovationen.

Als Research Alliances & Science Insourcing Lead bei Nestlé Research möchten Sie sicherstellen, dass Nestlé Research Zugang zu den besten Wissenschaften weltweit hat. Durch die Leitung von Forschungsallianzen, Science Insourcing und Scientific Intelligence stärken Sie den Zugang zu externem Fachwissen, wissenschaftlichem Wissen, Literatur und Innovationsökosystemen, die die wissenschaftlichen Fähigkeiten von Nestlé Research ergänzen und erweitern. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Forschungsleitern, Wissenschafts- und Technologieteams, Rechts- und Vertragspartnern, Universitäten, Forschungsinstituten, Start-ups, wissenschaftlichen Verlagen, Verbänden und externen Experten helfen Sie dabei, Ideen in nachhaltige und innovative Lösungen für Menschen, Haustiere und den Planeten zu verwandeln.

Wie Sie als Research Alliances & Science Insourcing Lead Einfluss nehmen können

• Führen der Forschungsallianzen und der Science-Insourcing-Strategie zum Aufbau hochwertiger Partnerschaften mit Hochschulen, Startups, Verlagen, wissenschaftlichen und Innovationsökosystemen.

• Förderung strategischer Kooperationen, die die Entdeckung beschleunigen, die Innovationswirkung stärken und die Prioritäten von Nestlé Research unterstützen.

• Schaffung eines nahtlosen Zugangs zu internen und externen wissenschaftlichen Erkenntnissen durch die Verbindung von Forschern mit Experten, wissenschaftlicher Literatur, Verlagen, Informationsquellen und Forschungsdiensten, die Nestlé Research Fähigkeiten erweitern.

• Die Transformation wissenschaftlicher Intelligenz in eine strategische Fähigkeit durch die Identifizierung, Verknüpfung und Übersetzung von aufkommenden wissenschaftlichen Trends, Publikationen und externem Fachwissen in umsetzbare Erkenntnisse für Forschung und Innovation.

• Stärkung des wissenschaftlichen Rufs von Nestlé Research durch den Aufbau vertrauenswürdiger Beziehungen zu Universitäten, Talentpools und externen Vordenkern.

• Entwicklung eines engagierten, integrativen und zukunftsfähigen Teams, das Fähigkeiten aufbaut, die Zusammenarbeit fördert und gemeinsame Prioritäten setzt.

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Bringen Sie einen PhD oder einen gleichwertigen wissenschaftlichen Hintergrund mit, kombiniert mit der Glaubwürdigkeit und Neugier, Spitzenwissenschaft mit Geschäftsanforderungen, Innovationsmöglichkeiten und langfristiger Wertschöpfung zu verbinden.

• Anwendung von mehr als 10 Jahren Erfahrung in Forschung und Entwicklung, wissenschaftlicher Innovation, externer Zusammenarbeit oder verwandter wissenschaftlicher Führung, um Strategien zu gestalten, Interessengruppen zu beeinflussen und messbare Auswirkungen zu erzielen.

• Nutzung starker Erfahrung in Nestlé Research, Nestlé Product Technology Centern und der breiteren F & E-Organisation, um Verbindungen zwischen Fähigkeiten, Partnerschaften, Fachwissen und wissenschaftlichen Dienstleistungen zu fördern und die Ausrichtung auf Geschäfts- und Innovationsprioritäten sicherzustellen.

• Nachweis des Erfolgs in akademischen Partnerschaften, Innovationsökosystemen, mit der nachgewiesenen Fähigkeit, vertrauenswürdige Beziehungen aufzubauen und messbare Auswirkungen zu erzielen.

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Leitung komplexer Initiativen in einer direkten oder indirekten Führungsrolle.

• Mitbringen von Erfahrung in der Verwaltung, Entwicklung oder strategischen Nutzung von wissenschaftlichen Infrastrukturen, Forschungsdienstleistungen, Wissensplattformen oder gemeinsamen Fähigkeiten.

• Demonstrieren starker strategischer Kommunikation und beeinflussender Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe wissenschaftliche Themen in überzeugende Narrative zu übersetzen, Ausrichtung aufzubauen und verschiedene interne und externe Interessengruppen einzubeziehen.

• Bringt Zusammenarbeit, intellektuelle Neugier, frisches Denken, konstruktive Herausforderung, Respekt und eine positive Denkweise.

Façonner l'avenir par des percées scientifiques et l'innovation.

Be a force for good and transform your potential into something extraordinary

As an Innovation Insight Intern at Nestlé Product Technology Centre Coffee, your mission will be to uncover emerging consumer needs, cultural shifts and marketplace signals, and translate them into meaningful opportunities for the future of coffee.

Working within the Front-End Innovation team, you will contribute to strategic projects across global coffee brands, including Nescafé, Starbucks, Nespresso, Nescafé Dolce Gusto. You will collaborate with innovation, consumer insights, design and R&D experts, gaining hands-on experience at the intersection of consumer understanding, foresight and innovation.

How you’ll make an impact as an Innovation Insight Intern

• Conduct trend scouting, foresight and social listening activities to identify emerging consumer behaviours, cultural shifts and future opportunities

• Map marketplace developments, brands and sources of inspiration to support innovation projects

• Contribute to qualitative and quantitative consumer research, data analysis and insight generation

• Help transform research findings into innovation territories, opportunity spaces and consumer-led concepts

• Create clear presentations, recommendations and compelling stories from complex information

• Support the preparation and facilitation of workshops with internal teams and external partners

• Support the AI-transformation journey of the team

• Explore and embed AI-powered approaches to accelerate innovation development and team workflows

What will make you successful

• Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Consumer Insights, Psychology, Sociology, Marketing, Business, Innovation, Statistics or a related field

• Initial experience or strong interest in consumer research, including qualitative or quantitative methods, trend analysis, strategy or innovation

• Ability to analyse and synthesize complex information and transform it into clear insights, recommendations and opportunity areas

• Confidence using PowerPoint and Canva, together with curiosity for generative AI tools. Familiarity with Excel and Mural is an advantage

• Strong written, visual and verbal storytelling skills, with fluency in English

• You demonstrate courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning while translating ideas into meaningful impact and creating shared value

At Nestlé, we place people at the heart of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office-based roles)

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and may close the role once a strong selection of relevant candidates has been identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information will be treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates through official company email addresses and will never request payments or sensitive personal information during the recruitment process.

Formare il futuro attraverso scoperte scientifiche e innovazione.

In qualità di Responsabile del Prodotto Scientifico presso Nestlé Research nel nostro dipartimento di Scienze Computazionali, la vostra missione sarà quella di possedere il ciclo di vita dei prodotti di dati scientifici in agricoltura, imballaggio, ricerca clinica, sicurezza alimentare e settori scientifici per la salute e la nutrizione - rinforzando e aumentando il valore delle basi dati di Nestlé Research. Come farete un impatto come responsabile del prodotto dei dati scientifici

Strategic Research Operations

Location: Lausanne, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time 100%
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Scientific Data Product Manager at Nestlé Research in our Computational Sciences department, your mission will be to own the lifecycle of scientific data products across agriculture, packaging, clinical research, food safety, and health & nutrition scientific domains - reinforcing and increasing value of Nestlé Research's data foundations. You will identify high-value opportunities, translate scientific needs into impactful data products, and lead cross-functional delivery from discovery through adoption and communicate the same through an engaging product roadmap.

How you’ll make an impact as a Scientific Data Product Manager

• Lead cross-functional workstreams in a dynamic research environment, defining product vision, requirements, priorities, and success criteria that align science, data, and technology.

• Partner with scientific stakeholders to identify high-value needs, improve data quality, strengthen metadata, and make research data more discoverable and reusable through FAIR principles.

• Translate scientific needs into scalable data products across bioinformatics, clinical, and omics pipelines, from discovery through adoption.

• Orchestrate internal experts — including scientists, data domain owners, architects, data scientists, engineers, and software developers — together with external partners to accelerate priority delivery.

• Champion AI-enabled data products, using automation and AI to turn trusted, well-governed scientific data into faster, smarter insights.

• Own scientific data products for the long term, balancing feasibility and impact while using adoption, satisfaction, and delivered value to guide continuous improvement.

What will make you successful

• Bachelors or Master’s or PhD in Bioinformatics, Life sciences, Chemistry or Computer Science, Engineering or equivalent, combining scientific domain understanding with data expertise.

• Significant professional experience driving the seeding, implementation, adoption and lifecycle management of data products in a scientific context, preferably in food, life sciences or pharma.

• Required expertise:

•

• Solid experience with Bioinformatics or Clinical or Omics research data domains

• Proven ability to identify business and scientific needs, perform stakeholder analysis, translate requirements into product backlogs, and prioritize delivery based on value, feasibility and strategic alignment.

• Strong product ownership skills, including roadmap management, backlog prioritization, user-centric design, value definition, testing strategies, adoption tracking and continuous improvement.

• Solid understanding of data engineering concepts, including data models, pipelines, ETL/ELT, APIs, metadata, data quality, data governance and analytics architectures, with the ability to guide technical decisions and challenge proposals.

• Understanding of modern data ecosystems - cloud platforms, data warehouse, (e.g., Snowflake), Linux and container technologies, orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow), DevOps practices.

• Nice-to-have expertise

• Semantic modeling, ontologies, and knowledge graphs (e.g., RDF/SPARQL, biomedical/chemical vocabularies).

• FAIR data implementation, metadata management, and lineage tooling

• Experience with reporting tools (e.g., DASH, Streamlit, Power BI) is an advantage

• Leadership experience

• Experience coordinating delivery through multidisciplinary internal teams and external partners.

• Ability to navigate complexity, manage ambiguity and align scientific, business and technical stakeholders around clear priorities.

• Experience in mentoring or guiding junior resources

• Excellent problem-solving, strong communication, stakeholder management and knowledge-sharing skills

• Fluent spoken and written English

At Nestlé Research, we place people at the core of everything we do.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Essere una forza per il bene e trasformare il vostro potenziale in qualcosa di straordinario

Come Interno SPX Data Analytics presso Nespresso®, la vostra missione sarà quella di trasformare i dati sensoriali e di esperienza dei prodotti in apprendimento attuabile per l'innovazione del caffè.

Supporterai la raccolta, la preparazione, l'analisi, la modellazione, la visualizzazione e la documentazione di grandi set di dati, contribuendo a un progetto di modellazione predittiva utilizzando l'apprendimento automatico. Lavorando a stretto contatto con il SPX Insight Specialist, SPX Data Specialist e partner in R&D, Marketing, Consumer & Market Intelligence, E-commerce e IT, si acquisirà esperienza pratica all'intersezione di scienza dei dati, intuizioni dei consumatori e innovazione del caffè.

Come farete un impatto come Interno SPX Data Analytics

• Preparare, analizzare, modellare i dati sensoriali e di prodotto (SPX) per sviluppare un modello predittivo utilizzando l'apprendimento automatico per generare intuizioni chiare e utili

• Supporta il reporting KPI e crea dashboard e visualizzazioni efficaci utilizzando strumenti come Power BI o KNIME

• Eseguire controlli di qualità dei dati e contribuire a migliorare l'efficienza, la riproducibilità e la tracciabilità delle attività di gestione dei dati

• Contribuisci al test e al miglioramento continuo degli strumenti di dati documentando i tuoi metodi, risultati e raccomandazioni

• Collabora con partner tecnici e non tecnici e presenta chiaramente i tuoi risultati al team SPX e agli stakeholder R&D più ampi

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Attualmente completando un Master in Scienza dei dati, Statistica, Scienza informatica, Business Analytics, Ingegneria, Scienza dei consumatori, Scienza sensoriale o un campo relativo

• Scienza dei dati e competenze di codifica, con conoscenze pratiche di Python o R. Experience (lavoro o accademico) con Snowflake, Power BI, KNIME o strumenti e piattaforme simili è un vantaggio

• Hands-on esperienza preparazione, analisi, modellazione e visualizzazione di dataset attraverso progetti accademici o pratici

• Capacità di interpretare i dati e comunicare i risultati con chiarezza sia al pubblico tecnico che non tecnico

• Curioso, analitico e dettagliato, con un approccio proattivo e orientato alla soluzione

• Fluente in inglese. Francese o un'altra lingua è un vantaggio

• Dimostrare coraggio, collaborazione, velocità e apprendimento continuo, traducendo le idee in un impatto misurabile e creando valore condiviso

A Nespresso, mettiamo le persone al centro di tutto quello che facciamo

Be a force for good and transform your potential into something extraordinary

As an SPX Data Analytics Intern at Nespresso , your mission will be to transform sensory and product experience data into actionable learning for coffee innovation.

You will support the collection, preparation, analysis, modelling, visualisation and documentation of large datasets while contributing to a predictive modelling project using machine learning. Working closely with the SPX Insight Specialist, SPX Data Specialist and partners across R&D, Marketing, Consumer & Market Intelligence, E-commerce and IT, you will gain hands-on experience at the intersection of data science, consumer insights and coffee innovation.

How you’ll make an impact as an SPX Data Analytics Intern

• Prepare, analyse, model sensory and product experience (SPX) data in order to develop a predictive model using machine learning to generate clear and useful insights

• Support KPI reporting and create effective dashboards and visualisations using tools such as Power BI or KNIME

• Perform data-quality checks and help improve the efficiency, reproducibility and traceability of data-management activities

• Contribute to the testing and continuous improvement of data tools while documenting your methods, findings and recommendations

• Collaborate with technical and non-technical partners and present your findings clearly to the SPX team and broader R&D stakeholders

What will make you successful

• Currently completing a Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Business Analytics, Engineering, Consumer Science, Sensory Science or a related field

• Data science and coding skills, with practical knowledge of Python or R. Experience (work or academic) with Snowflake, Power BI, KNIME or similar tools and platforms is an advantage

• Hands-on experience preparing, analysing, modelling and visualising datasets through academic or practical projects

• Ability to interpret data and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

• Curious, analytical and detail-oriented, with a proactive and solution-focused approach

• Fluent in English. French or another language is an advantage

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value

At Nespresso, we place people at the heart of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office-based roles)

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to start your career journey with us?

Apply now and transform your potential into something extraordinary.

Wie Sie als SPX Data Analytics Intern etwas bewirken können

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Derzeit Abschluss eines Master-Abschlusses in Data Science, Statistik, Informatik, Business Analytics, Engineering, Consumer Science, Sensory Science oder einem verwandten Bereich

• Fähigkeit, Daten zu interpretieren und Erkenntnisse sowohl für technische als auch für nicht-technische Zielgruppen klar zu kommunizieren

• Neugierig, analytisch und detailorientiert, mit proaktivem und lösungsorientiertem Ansatz

• Demonstrieren Sie Mut, Zusammenarbeit, Geschwindigkeit und kontinuierliches Lernen, während Sie Ideen in messbare Auswirkungen übersetzen und gemeinsame Werte schaffen

• Gesundheitsbeitrag und Zugang zum Employee Assistance Program

• Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte für verschiedene Produkte und Dienstleistungen

Wir verpflichten uns zu einer inklusiven und respektvollen einstellungserfahrung und freuen uns, bei bedarf angemessene unterkünfte zu bieten. Unsere Arbeitsplätze sind vollständig zugänglich und werden von einer starken Sicherheitskultur mit modernen Installationen und Verfahren unterstützt, um eine sichere Umgebung für alle zu gewährleisten.

Der Einstellungsprozess umfasst in der Regel ein Interview mit Talent Acquisition, ein Interview mit dem Einstellungsteam und eine abschließende Diskussion und ein Angebot. Wir überprüfen Bewerbungen, sobald sie eingegangen sind, und schließen die Rolle, sobald eine starke Liste relevanter Kandidaten identifiziert wurde, daher empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich frühzeitig zu bewerben. Alle Informationen werden vertraulich behandelt.

Bleiben Sie wachsam: Nestlé wird die Kandidaten nur über offizielle Firmen-E-Mail-Adressen kontaktieren und zu keinem Zeitpunkt des Einstellungsprozesses Zahlungen oder sensible persönliche Informationen verlangen.

• Capacité d'interpréter les données et de communiquer clairement les résultats aux publics techniques et non techniques

• Curieux, analytique et axé sur les détails, avec une approche proactive et axée sur les solutions

• En anglais. Le français ou une autre langue est un avantage

Essere una forza per il bene e sentirsi fidati di prendere decisioni che importa.

In qualità di Global Procurement Manager for Contract Manufacturing presso Nestlé Global Procurement, la vostra missione è quella di guidare le attività commerciali e sourcing per la categoria Global Contract Manufacturing. Segnalando al Global Categoria Lead, definirai e implementerai strategie di categoria, guiderai iniziative strategiche di approvvigionamento e collaborerai con stakeholder interfunzionali per fornire valore, ottimizzare le prestazioni dei fornitori e sostenere la crescita aziendale.

Operiamo su scala mondiale, mettendo insieme oltre 40 nazionalità in tre hub dinamici in Svizzera, Panama e Malesia. As Global Marketing Lead Inflammatory Bowel Diseases & Modulen® Brand Lead at Nestlé Nutrition & Health , your mission is to develop and lead the global strategy that will help Nestlé win in Inflammatory Bowel Diseases, while providing global brand leadership for Modulen®. You will make a difference by shaping the innovation pipeline, lead cross-functional teams, and work closely with Medical Affairs, R&D, Regulatory, Market Access, Sales, Finance, Operations, Zones and key markets to deliver growth, strengthen portfolio performance and bring meaningful solutions to patients, healthcare professionals and caregivers. • Leading the global strategy for Inflammatory Bowel Diseases to strengthen Nestlé’s relevance with patients, healthcare professionals and caregivers.

• Providing global leadership for Modulen® as a differentiated, science-led brand through clear positioning, strong claims and compelling communication.

• Driving innovation from insight to launch readiness by translating patient, customer, payer, product and competitor needs into meaningful growth opportunities.

• Bringing strong medical and scientific acumen, with the ability to translate evidence, medical topics and claims into relevant patient, customer and business insights.

• Applying knowledge of regulatory frameworks, healthcare systems, market access, claims development and approval processes to support compliant and impactful brand growth.

• Building strong brand positioning, unique selling propositions, claims and value propositions that resonate with healthcare professionals, caregivers and patients.

• Turning strategy into action by leading change, staying resourceful and driving impact through collaboration, influence and clear communication.

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Specialist Macronutrient Physiology at Nestlé Research, you will be part of the Metabolic Health team within the Nestlé Institute of Health Sciences (NIHS) and your mission will be to provide scientific expertise in nutrition physiology to help develop nutrition-based health solutions and translate mechanistic insight into actionable dietary recommendations and intervention concepts. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with cross-functional scientists and technical teams across Nestlé Research, Nutrition & Health and other R&D centers. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as a Specialist Macronutrient Physiology

• Developing and executing cross-business research that advances understanding of macro- and micronutrient metabolism and nutrient quality.

• Analyzing and interpreting clinical & pre-clinical data on linking diet and metabolism to generate high-quality hypotheses and mechanistic insight.

• Strengthening the scientific evidence of on macro- micronutrient quality by moving from observed clinical correlations to causal modes of action & physiological mechanisms across populations and life stages.

• Designing and contributing to innovative nutrient-based intervention concepts, techniques, and research approaches that support breakthrough innovation.

• Translating scientific outputs into actionable recommendations, innovation inputs, and robust intellectual property support aligned to R&D priorities.

• Communicating and networking internally and externally through publications, presentations, and partnerships that build credibility and accelerate impact.

What will make you successful
